description: Sets a store's public name and logos, which Leal uses on cards, posters and signup pages. Logos are fetched from public image URLs (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG). Replaces the current values.

logo_url.description: Public https URL of the wide logo.

square_logo_url.description: Public https URL of a square logo or icon.

store_id.description: Store id from list_stores. Optional when the login has one store.

store_name.description: The business name customers know, e.g. "Bean There Coffee".

name: update_store
title: Update store name and logo
